name: Hero's Burden

start.dialog: There's a village on the Mire's edge being harassed by beasts. A HERO is needed! That's me! ...And you too, I guess! Let's go save some people!
start.objective: Accompany Snow to defend the Mire edge village from beast attacks

progress.dialog: The beasts are coming! I've got the big ones! You take the small fry!
progress.objective: Defeat waves of beasts attacking the village

complete.dialog: We saved them! The village is safe! Another win for Team NORA! Here - my coat. It's seen a lot of battles. Maybe it'll protect you too.

party_comments.kade: He's reckless. But his heart's in the right place.
party_comments.twist: He punched that monster in the FACE! Awesome!
party_comments.vex: True heroism is not about glory. He will learn this.

hidden_outcome: If you protect all villagers without any damage to buildings, Snow gives you 'Umbra' - a powerful coat with high defense
